reason: I already have my own bike, and when I can't ride it I take the bus or get a lift to training. With only 10 bikes in town I wouldn't count on one being near me in the evening anyway.
objection: Why pay for a bike when mine is free and standing at home? With 10 bikes I'd probably have to walk to find one, and it's only worth it if it's right there when I need it.
would_change_my_mind: If my own bike broke or got stolen and there was a bike reliably parked near my home and near the training hall, I'd try the 5 € pupil month.
